Sandbox_SkillLimiter_Enable_tooltip: Limits each skill according to the levels granted by the character's profession and traits.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_AgilityBonus_toolti: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to every Agility skill before profession and trait bonuses are counted.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_CombatBonus_tooltip: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to every melee combat skill before profession and trait bonuses are counted.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_CraftingBonus_toolt: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to every Crafting skill before profession and trait bonuses are counted.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_FirearmBonus_toolti: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to Aiming and Reloading before profession and trait bonuses are counted.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_SurvivalistBonus_to: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to every Survival skill before profession and trait bonuses are counted.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PassivesBonus: Starting tier bonus: Fitness and Strength
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PassivesBonus_toolt: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to Fitness and Strength. The default value of 3 effectively leaves them uncapped.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_MusicBonus_tooltip: Adds 0 to 3 tier points to Lifestyle's Music skill before profession and trait bonuses are counted. Set it to 0 to use only the character's actual starting bonuses.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkLvl0Cap_tooltip: Maximum level for a skill that receives no points from profession, traits, category bonus or custom bonus.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkLvl1Cap_tooltip: Maximum level for a skill whose total starting bonus is exactly 1 point.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkLvl2Cap_tooltip: Maximum level for a skill whose total starting bonus is exactly 2 points.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkLvl3Cap: Maximum level with 3 or more starting points
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkLvl3Cap_tooltip: Maximum level for a skill whose total starting bonus is 3 points or more.
Sandbox_SkillLimiter_PerkBonuses_tooltip: Optional semicolon-separated list using perk ID and bonus pairs. IDs are case-insensitive and points are added before selecting the tier.
